# Theoretical Linear Algebra — Eigenvectors and Structure

Book Chapter 6 moves into eigenvectors, special matrices, abstract spaces, Gram–Schmidt and decompositions. The abstract ideas grow from ordinary arrows.

## Follow the chapters

1. [eigenvalues and eigenvectors](01-eigenvalues-and-eigenvectors.qmd)
2. [gram schmidt](02-gram-schmidt.qmd)
3. [matrix decompositions](03-matrix-decompositions.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Theoretical Linear Algebra — Eigenvectors and Structure. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
